title: Monotonicity of randomized space
statement: Let $s_1,s_2:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $s_1(n)\le s_2(n)$ for every $n$. Then every language decidable with bounded error using space bounded by a constant multiple of $s_1$ belongs to the class decidable with bounded error using space bounded by a constant multiple of $s_2$.
